strategy-and-advisory.covers: Strategy & Advisory is where most engagements start: a clear look at where your organisation stands and what to do next. We review the evidence, set out the options and write down a plan with owners and measures. Every recommendation is yours to accept or decline.

company-formation-and-secretarial.covers: Company Formation & Secretarial covers choosing and registering the right entity with the Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC), Nigeria's company registry, and then keeping its corporate records in order: board and shareholder documents, registers, ownership and structure changes. Founders and investors abroad can complete every step remotely.

compliance-and-regulatory.covers: Compliance & Regulatory keeps your organisation in good standing after registration: annual returns, beneficial ownership, tax registration and recurring returns, licences and permits, and data protection. We map every obligation, track the dates and file within the agreed scope.

finance-and-accounting.covers: Finance & Accounting covers the numbers that run the organisation and the documents that raise money: books, payroll, management accounts, cash-flow planning, business plans, investment readiness, grant and tender submissions, and tax planning with licensed tax practitioners.

hr-and-operations.covers: HR & Operations covers the people, processes and suppliers behind day-to-day work: HR records and policies, recruitment, written procedures, procurement, project management and outsourced administration, including remote operations support for international firms.

technology-and-digital.covers: Technology & Digital covers the systems your organisation runs on: websites, CRM, workflow automation, dashboards, online payments, and the policies and risk assessments for adopting AI and digital tools responsibly. Everything is handed over with training and documentation.

marketing-and-communications.covers: Marketing & Communications covers how your organisation is seen and heard: brand identity, social media and advertising, company profiles and proposals, sales training, customer loyalty and crisis communications planning.
